name: Guacamole (Chile- and Herb-Free)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Gently slice avocado and remove pit.
Add avocado to a bowl and mash until smooth.
If desired, eat with chips, bread, or salad.

culture.text: Guacamole, sometimes informally shortened to guac in the United States, is an avocado-based dip, spread, or salad first developed in Mexico. In addition to its use in modern Mexican cuisine, it has become part of international cuisine as a dip, condiment, and salad ingredient.
